notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added the options to review tutorials through the Pause Menu
[*] Updated tutorials 
[*] Bullets no longer collide with each other
[*] Minor changes to set-dressing
[*] Minor changes to SFXs
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixing:[/b]
[list]
[*] Addressed bug where Monster was getting stuck in Arena 3
[*] Addressed bug where Main Menu music was playing during the intro cinematic
[*] Addressed bug where flying Enemies were trying to go through the ceiling in Arena 3
[/list]

notes.title: Credits Screen Added
notes.content:
[b]Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Credits Screen once Player reaches the end-crystal
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new crosshair visuals
[*] Updated all onboarding pop-ups throughout the entire game
[*] Changed 'Tab' (command monster) to Middle Mouse Button
[*] Changed '2' (lighting shot) to 'Q'
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixing:[/b]
[list]
[*] Addressed bug where ping icon was only visible when 'Tab' was pressed
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated set dressing
[*] Updated UI and HUD visuals
[*] Updated various SFX
[*] Added custom cursor icon
[*] Added 'ping' icons (Commanding Monster Ability)
[*] Toggle between Player and Monster abilities by using 'Tab' (Commanding Monster is a combination of 'Tab' + 'E'/'R')
[*] Stair collision now uses a slope collision rather than individual steps
[*] Reduced height of water kill triggers within the Level
[*] Increased intro video duration and changed its subtitles
[*] Changed dash cooldown from 0.01 to 0.25
[*] Monster automatically marks and attacks enemies, until commanded by the Player otherwise
[*] Monster now runs to the Player if the Player is far away
[*] Settings Menu options now include 'Off' option where applicable (e.g., Motion Blur)
[*] Polished animations
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixing:[/b]
[list]
[*] Addressed bug where UI visuals were twitching 
[*] Addressed bug where Player health was being reduced with a slight delay
[*] Addressed bug where Main Menu was clickable from other Menus
[*] Addressed bug where game crashed after reopening the Bug Reporter
[*] Addressed bug where Monster was stuck in Arena 3 (along with some other places)
[*] Addressed 7 more bugs
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
[b]Bug Fixing:[/b]
Addressed bug where the save slot wouldn't load upon 'Play Again' or 'Continue'. Save/Load system now functions normally.

Apologies for the inconvenience and all the frustrations created by this bug. We hope that by addressing this bug, the user experience will improve.

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
Bug Fixing:
Addressed Bug where tutorial pop ups didn't appear

We are aware that currently the game is starting from the beginning each time you lose. That is a bug we are actively trying to solve and we expect to be pushing another Hotfix by the end of today. We appreciate your patience.

notes.title: Patch Notes

Added frogs in the water
Updated set-dressing 
Changed fire VFX
Changed enemy dodge VFX
Increased various animation frames
Now a different save slot is created for each patch

Addressed bug where Monster health-bar wasn't accurate
Addressed bug where Monster would remain stuck outside of Arena 3
Addressed bug where a SFX was still audible at 0 volume
Addressed bug where SteamVR would start upon booting the game
Addressed bug where 'Play Again' would start a New Game
Addressed bug where AI Debugger would show up in the Shipping Build
Addressed bug where Nav-mesh was broken in Arena 3
Addressed bug where on 'Continue' the intro video wasn't shown if a save slot didn't exist
Addressed bug where the charge-command ping icon would go away before the Monster could charge again
Addressed 7 more bugs
